name: Naagin
description: A miraculous shape-shifting snake has the power to become a human. She can be anybody she wants: a wife, a seductress, a mistress, a damsel in distress: all in the name of revenge.

videos.title: A Mysterious Woman Haunts Ritik
videos.overview: Rithik follows a woman in his dream and the woman turns into a snake and bites him. His mother is informed that only Rithik's marriage can save him from the impending danger.

videos.title: The Naagin Begins With Her Revenge Plan
videos.overview: Rithik's engagement at the Haveli faces unexpected obstacles. Meanwhile, the Naagins, Sesha and Shivanya, are finally free to take any form after 20 years.

videos.title: Sesha's Truth Revealed?
videos.overview: Sesha reaches the mansion disguised as a dancer and mixes poison in the drinks but no one is harmed. Yamini finds Sesha turning into a snake.

videos.title: Shivanya Re-enters The House
videos.overview: Tanvi and Hrithik's engagement is underway when Shivanya re-enters Hrithik's house with the help of Sesha. She intends to avenge her parent's death.

videos.title: Viren's Attempts to Get Intimate With Shivanya
videos.overview: Shivanya confronts Viren's advances at the Raheja house.  Ritwik rescues her from Viren's blackmail, leading to a blossoming romance between Shivanya and Ritwik.

videos.title: The Truth About Hrithik's Horoscope
videos.overview: Ankush and Yamini find a shocking poster and hide it. Hrithik claims he's marrying Tanvi for her happiness but Yamini reveals the truth about his horoscope.

videos.title: Conflict At The Wedding Ceremony.
videos.overview: Shivanya's bite thwarts Tanvi's wedding. Yamini's stunned reaction to Shivanya as the bride ignites Shivanya's revenge, forcing Yamini to accept her marriage to Rithik.

videos.title: A Marriage Made In Heaven
videos.overview: Hritik's mother arranges his marriage to Shivanya, who saved his life, instead of his beloved Tanvi. Hritik, despite his love for Shivanya, offers her freedom.

videos.title: An Unexpected Blessing For Shivanya
videos.overview: Yogiraj's blessing guides Shivanya towards love, not revenge. Meanwhile, Ankush's visions unveil Suri as the fourth culprit.

videos.title: Naagin Unleashed
videos.overview: A servant's discovery of a snake skin near the temple prompts the priest to burn it, hoping to draw the snake out. Sesha fears for Shivanya's safety and prays for her protection.

videos.title: Sesha to Kill Suri
videos.overview: Shivanya suspects Suri in her parents' death, noticing his six fingers. But Shesha, impatient, plans to kill him at the airport.

videos.title: Naagin's Vengance
videos.overview: Tanvi tells her parents that she heard Shivanya talk about revenge. Later, as Sushim informs Ankush about the Naagin's return. Shesha and Shivanya overhear their conversation.

videos.title: Naagin Ploys Killers Against Each Other
videos.overview: Shivanya takes the form of an astrologer named Ramya and warns the killers. Later, Sesha takes the form of Monisha and tricks Sailesh into seducing the real Monisha.

videos.title: Naagin's Close Escape
videos.overview: Rithik reveals his love for Shivanya, but Tanvi questions her. Guruma uses magic against Sesha, who plots Suri's death in the temple.

videos.title: Will Shivanya Attend The Mahakali Puja?
videos.overview: Suri's shock: Shivanya's at the temple! Guruma orders a 'Mahakali Puja' to expel the 'naagin', forcing Shivanya and Rithik to participate.

videos.title: Ritik is Poisoned
videos.overview: Shivanya saves Ritik from the poison given by Sesha. Later, Sesha prays for a storm which endangers Ankush's and his family's life.

videos.title: Shivanya Fights Mahakali
videos.overview: Kali Ma possesses a young girl and kills Sesha. Later, Shivanya uses the idol of Lord Shiva and pleads to Kali Ma to give back the lives she has taken.

videos.title: Naagin Enters The Haveli
videos.overview: Shivanya persuades Goddess Kali to side with the innocent snakes. Shivanya and Ritik go to the old Haveli; Sesha disrupts Guruma's prayers and bites her.

videos.title: Dewvdi's Secret
videos.overview: Shivanya and Ritik face strange happenings at the old mansion. Guruma traps Sesha in the cave. Back home, Yamini and Ankush confront them.

videos.title: Sesha and Shivanya Wins Yet Again.
videos.overview: Guruma traps Sesha. Shivanya, bitten by a snake, begs Rithik to take her to Gurumaa.  While Rithik and Gurumaa seek herbs, Shivanya rescues Sesha from the cave.

videos.title: The Wrong Locket.
videos.overview: Shivanya's secret visit to the Naagin temple is discovered by Yamini. Shesha steps in to save the day by switching lockets. Meanwhile, Kabir arrives at Ankush's to see Thanvi.

videos.title: Sesha Plans to Kill Sailesh Mathur
videos.overview: Sesha, disguised as Ankur, steals Sailesh's ring at the Kya Kool Hain Hum-3 premiere. She lures him to Shiv Mandir, setting the stage for a deadly plot with Shivanya.

videos.title: Kabir Kills Tanvi.
videos.overview: Tanvi sees Shivanya and Shesha transforming into serpents. Kabir transforms into a big Mongoose in front of Tanvi and kills her. The fake Kabir kills the real Kabir.

videos.title: Kabir Tries to Kill Shivanya.
videos.overview: Rithik grieves over Tanvi's death. Kabir tries to kill Shivanya but Gurudev saves her. Sesha and Shivanya want to find the mongoose. Kabir traps Sesha.

videos.title: Shivanya and Sesha Kill Kabir
videos.overview: Rithik tells Shivanya that he saw a dream about a diamond. Shivanya takes Kabir's watch to Guruji. A masked man comes and kills Suri's wife.

videos.title: Nagapanchami Day
videos.overview: Monisha is shot by a stranger. Shesha suspects Rithvik, but the truth is revealed - Ankush is the killer.  Nagapanchami rituals unfold in Ankush's house.

videos.title: Shivanya is Stabbed
videos.overview: Shivanya, poisoned by a dagger, fights for survival as Gurudev attempts a cure. Sesha, her transformed clone, discovers a mark on Ritik that echoes a legend in the book "Naagmani."

videos.title: Shivanya's Journey Through The Dark Forest
videos.overview: Shivanya and Shesha, vengeful ichchadari naagins, seek retribution for their parents' murder at the hands of Ankush, Viren, and others.

videos.title: Guruma Looses All Her Powers
videos.overview: Guruma's failed attacks leave the Naagin vulnerable. She races to the Rahejas for help, while Gurudev unveils the Naagmani's power to revive Shivanya.

videos.title: Shivanya Returns Home
videos.overview: Shivanya reunites with a Sesha-controlled Ritik. Rejecting his enchanted love, she forces him away, defying Remya's accusations of being a Naagin, confirmed false by Guruma.

videos.title: Shivanya Gets Her Powers Back
videos.overview: Katak and Sesha restore Shivanya's powers through ancient rituals. Lord Krishna intervenes, granting her strength. She exacts revenge on Shailesh and his men.

videos.title: Ritik Witnesses The Killing Of Shailesh
videos.overview: Shivanya's resurrected powers claim Shailesh's life. Traumatized Ritik alerts the family, leaving them shocked. Sesha aids Shivanya in retrieving the Mang Tika.

videos.title: Shivanya Invokes The Naagmani
videos.overview: Shivanya dances to awaken the naagmani, while Sesha fights to keep Ritik and Guruma away. Ankush seeks the naagmani, but the Naagins stand guard.

videos.title: Yamini Tries to Steal Nagmani
videos.overview: Yamini's attempt to steal the Nagmani from the cave fails as the auspicious time passes. She postpones her plan. Meanwhile, Shivanya rescues an unconscious Ritik from the temple.

videos.title: Sangram Singh Escapes From The Cave
videos.overview: Sangram Singh, after running away from the cave, decides to find his son at any cost. Later, he reveals that he never expected his sister Yamini to betray him and wreck his life.

videos.title: The Serpent's Gem
videos.overview: Manipulated by Yamini, Rithik seeks the serpent's gem, while Sesha and Shivanya try to stop him. But Yamini's betrayal sends Maharaj Sangram Singh to his death.

videos.title: Shivanya Saves Ritik's Life
videos.overview: Shivanya hunts her parents' killer, but the Naag mani yields no clues. Ankush attacks Ritik, thwarted by Shivanya. Sesha finds Ritik's father and the Naag mani missing.

videos.title: The Mystery Of The Naagmani
videos.overview: Guruma introduces Mayuri, her new assistant, to lure Ritik. Meanwhile, Sesha investigates the Naagmani, following in her father's footsteps.

videos.title: The Mysterious Powers Of Mayuri
videos.overview: Mayuri reveals Shesha's true form to Yamini, using a mirror and her powers.  Later, she mysteriously injures Shivanya to further expose her identity.

videos.title: The Duel Between Shesha and Mayuri
videos.overview: Shesha confronts Mayuri for secretly attacking Shivanya and tries to kill her. However, Mayuri defeats Shesha in the fight and holds her captive in an attempt to seize the nagmani.

videos.title: Mahishmati Race to Destroy Human Race
videos.overview: Sangram Singh reads an ancient book and learns that Mahishmati race is on its way to destroy the human race. Meanwhile when Mayuri captures Shesha, she gets killed by Shivanya.

videos.title: Finding The Fifth Murderer
videos.overview: Yamini's treachery is exposed when Ritik (Shesha) attacks Sangram. Shivanya, as Sangram, confronts Yamini, demanding the fifth killer's name. Yamini retaliates with accusations.

videos.title: The Aghoris Capture Shivanya
videos.overview: Shivanya, while shopping, is abducted by Aghoris and tortured in a fiery ordeal.  She loses her Mangalsutra, while Sesha's love for Ritik deepens.

videos.title: Ritik The Saviour
videos.overview: Sesha joins Shivanya's fight against the Aghoris, but gets trapped. Ritik arrives with the police, saving them and the other serpents.

videos.title: Yamini Plots Yet Again
videos.overview: Yamini manipulates Ankush to get a Naagin killed. Her tears and cunning scheme turn Shivanya against Ankush. Will they see through her deceit?

videos.title: Dangerous Omens
videos.overview: Shivanya's heartbreak deepens as Sesha nearly marries Ritik, but Ankush's arrest and Yamini's temple discovery of an unconscious Guru Maa disrupt the chaos. Sangram foresees doom.

videos.title: Yamini's Truth is Revealed
videos.overview: Shivanya chases Yamini, thief of the powerful Naagmani, into a cavern. Will Shivanya stop Yamini before she claims ultimate power?

videos.title: Sesha Cohorts With Yamini
videos.overview: Sesha and Yamini combine forces to attain the Nagmani. Later, they attempt to kill Shivanya and stop her from being a hurdle. Will they succeed in incapacitating her?

videos.title: Shivanya is Trapped
videos.overview: Shivanya, posing as Sesha, tries to seduce Ritik, but her secret's out. Fleeing Guru Maa, she must reveal a shocking truth about his parents. Will he believe her?

videos.title: Shivanya Confronts Sesha
videos.overview: Ritik's world shatters when Yamini exposes Shivanya's secret. Sesha attacks, and Yamini tricks Ritik into killing Shivanya to save their family. Can love survive?

videos.title: Yamini's Killing Spree
videos.overview: Yamini murders Shivanya, then throws Ritik into the sea. Resurrected by the shivling, Shivanya rescues Ritik. Can she find the Nagamani to save him?

videos.title: Ritik is Resurrected
videos.overview: Shivanya uses the Naagmani to save Ritik and reunite him with his father. Sesha's freedom comes at Guru Dev's cost. Yamini's evil catches up to her.

videos.title: Yamini Loses Her Mind
videos.overview: Yamini, armed and ready, hears of Ritik's return. But Ritik's fate is tied to protecting the Naagamani, not becoming a Naag. Will Shivanya finally find justice?

videos.title: The Sacrilegious Union
videos.overview: Guru Maa's dark magic summons a deadly tornado, trapping Ritik and Shivanya in ice. Ritik's rescue leads to intimacy, but at what cost?

videos.title: Sangram Gets Shot
videos.overview: Sesha's theft of the Naagmani is thwarted by Shivanya, only for Sangram (under Guru Maa's control) to steal it. A gunfight leaves Sangram wounded.

videos.title: Kabeer Returns to Kill Naagin
videos.overview: Bee-stung Sangram seeks revenge on Ritik, turning evil. Meanwhile, Kabir returns to fight the Naagins, allying with Sesha. Their shared hatred masks deeper, personal vendettas.

videos.title: Shivanya Comes Face to Face With Kabir
videos.overview: Sesha, disguised as Remya, leads Shivanya to her room. Kabir, lured by Sesha, enters to kill Shivanya. Will Ritik save her?

videos.title: Viren Gets Shot
videos.overview: Yamini finds Ritik faked-imprisoned by a Naagin. He escapes to save Shivanya, leading to a showdown with Viren and the police, ending in Viren's shooting.

videos.title: Shivanya Seeks Sesha's Help
videos.overview: A deadly attack by Sesha turns Shivanya into a snake. Kabir, a mongoose, fights Sesha, then kidnaps Ritik. Shivanya must make a dangerous deal with Sesha for Ritik's rescue.

videos.title: Shivanya and Sesha Kill Kabir
videos.overview: Shivanya and Sesha defeat Kabir, freeing Ritik. But Yamini and Sesha plot to reignite the ancient Chandravanshi-Suryavanshi feud. Can Shivanya stop them?

videos.title: The Wrath Of Kali Maa
videos.overview: Shivanya and Ritik's ritual to summon Kali Maa is interrupted by Yamini's attack. But Shivanya gains the goddess's power. Will Yamini face the wrath of Kali Maa?

videos.title: The Battle For The Naagmani Reaches Fever Pitch
videos.overview: Ritik and Shivanya face their ultimate challenge as Queen Avantika and Sesha join forces against them, threatening to steal the Naagmani.

videos.title: The Saga Continues
videos.overview: The story takes a new turn as Shivanya gives birth to a baby girl. As Shivangi grows up bearing same features of her mother, Shivanya tries to keep her daughter away from the dark past. But destiny awaits to confront Shivangi's true identity on 'Kal Ratri'.

videos.title: Will Shivangi and Ruchika Cross Paths?
videos.overview: In an attempt to get Shivangi married before her 25th birthday, Shivanya gets her daughter to meet Aditya in a club. Coincidentally, Rocky happens to be there with Ruchika. Rocky makes it clear to Yamini that he is not in favour of getting engaged to Ruchika. On the other hand, Shivangi gives in to her mother's request and agrees to marry Aditya.

videos.title: Shivangi Confesses Her Love For Rocky
videos.overview: On being questioned about her feelings for Rocky, Shivangi confesses her love for him to Shivanya. Earlier, Rocky gets into a fight with Aditya to prove his love for Shivangi and make her realise her feelings as well. Later, Yamini and Sesha plan to kill the girl involved with Rocky. Will they be successful?

videos.title: Shivangi's Life In Danger!
videos.overview: Shivangi is shot at the party and is rushed to the hospital. Shivanya performs a 'Tandav' at the temple to bring Shivangi back to life. Later, Shivanya senses danger and urges Shivangi to get married to Rocky as soon as possible. Being informed by Yamini about Shivanya and her daughter's existence, Ruchika sets out to kill Shivangi.

videos.title: Shocker - Yamini Stabs Shivanya!
videos.overview: With the help of Ruchika, Yamini plots the marriage ceremony of Shivangi and Rocky where she confronts Shivanya and stabs her! After 25 years, Ruchika breaks the wall and releases Mahishmati Avantika from the curse. In order to take the revenge, Avantika plans to kill Shivanya and Shivangi.

videos.title: Shivangi's Wedding Turns Into a Nightmare!
videos.overview: The Mahishmatis seek revenge by killing everyone in Shivanya's family. Thirsting for blood, Ruchika and Yamini stab Shivanya and get hold of Shivangi with an intention to kill her. After the massacre, Ruchika abducts Shivangi. Where will Shivangi's destiny take her?

videos.title: Shivangi Vows to Avenge Shivanya's Killers!
videos.overview: In a shocking twist of events it is revealed that Shivanya impersonated Shivangi in order to save her daughter from death. Earlier, Ruchika throws Shivanya down the cliff in the presence of Yamini and Mahishmati. They presume Shivangi to be dead. Later, Shivangi gets to know the truth about her mother and vows to avenge her mother's death. However, Shivangi thinks even Rocky is responsible for her mother's death. Will she be able to forgive Rocky or will it be the end of their love story?

videos.title: Will Shivangi Transform Into a 'naagin'?
videos.overview: Shivangi seeks answers from the 'sadhu' and asks if she is also a 'Naagin' like her mother, Meanwhile, Yamini fakes a heart attack and tries to emotionally manipulate Rocky into marrying Ruchika. A shattered Shivangi performs a 'Tandav'. Will she transform into a 'Naagin'? Later, the search for the truth about the 'naagamani' takes Shivangi to her father's 'haveli', where she sees a picture of Yamini with Ritik.

videos.title: Shivangi Attempts Suicide!
videos.overview: Ruchika, Yamini and Mahishmati follow the 'Naagmani's luminescence and arrive at the Shiva temple. However, even after multiple attempts, none of them are successful in picking up the 'Naagmani' and they realise that only a true 'suryavanshi' is worthy of it. Meanwhile, Shivangi is intimidated by the supernatural powers possessed by the deadly trio and jumps off a cliff to stop the 'Naagmani' from ending up in the wrong hands. Is this the end of Shivangi?

videos.title: And They're Married
videos.overview: After surviving a fatal fall, Shivangi transforms into a Naagin and finally accepts her identity. In a shocking twist, Yamini tells Shivangi to wear the bridal outfit and get ready to marry Rocky who is waiting at the mandap. What is Yamini's hidden motive and how will Ruchika react? Watch Shivangi marry Rocky all in a bid to avenge her mother's murder.

videos.title: Shivangi All Set to Avenge Her Mother's Killers!
videos.overview: Shivangi takes her first step to avenge Shivanya's death by stepping into Rocky's house as his newly wedded bride. Filled with vengeance, Ruchika welcomes Shivangi by performing the latter's 'Griha Pravesh'. Earlier, Ruchika is calmed down by Yamini who informs her to hold onto her anger until they get hold of the 'naagmani'. Gurudev helps Shivangi with the mantra to change her human form at any time she wishes to. The trap is set. Shivangi is out to get her first victim. Who will it be?

videos.title: Shivangi Gets Her First Victim!
videos.overview: After impersonating Ruchika and sending a text message through Ruchika's phone, Shivangi tricks Amar into coming to the Maa Kali temple. She gets him killed brutally. However, the blame shifts on Ruchika, who despite being arrested manages to get the police commissioner killed and lands back home safely. Earlier, while Shivangi kills Amar, a man watches from a distance. Later, he comes to the house posing himself as advocate Shrivastava. What are his intentions?

videos.title: Shivangi and The 'naag' Join Forces
videos.overview: After hearing the story of the 'Naag' who is posing as Advocate Shrivastava, Shivangi joins forces with him to avenge her mother's death. They plan to create a rift between Ruchika, Yamini and Mahishmati. Will they succeed? Later, Shivangi and the 'Naag' lure the trio to the 'haveli' where their powers weaken.

videos.title: Yamini Decides to Expose Shivangi's Identity!
videos.overview: After decoding the mystery behind Amar's horrific death, Yamini becomes certain that an 'Ichchhadhari Naagin' is on a killing spree. To determine whether Shivangi is the 'Ichchhadhari Naagin', Yamini conjures a deadly scorpion and lets it loose on Shivangi. Will the scorpion reveal Shivangi's true identity?

videos.title: Shivangi has The Venom to Kill Avantika
videos.overview: After procuring the venom which will kill Rani Avantika, Shivangi plans her next move. Subsequently, disguising himself as Vikram, Rudra lures Rani Avantika to the cliff where Shivangi can put her plan into action. Meanwhile, Rudra's cover gets blown and is attacked by Rani Avantika and Ruchika. As they engage in battle, Shivangi gets trapped in a beehive, but manages to poison Avantika. Is this the end of Rani Avantika?

videos.title: Mahishmatis Get a 'kawach'
videos.overview: Frustrated over not knowing the identity of their attackers, the Mahishmatis get a sacred pendent to act as a 'kawach' for them. Earlier, Rani Avantika survives being poisoned and Rudra's identity is almost revealed, but he manages to deceive the Mahishmatis. Later, Shivangi manages to get rid of Vikram's 'kawach'. But, will she be able to kill him?

videos.title: Rudra is Killed By The Mahishmatis
videos.overview: After acquiring the 'Naagjalmani', the Mahishmatis summon Rudra. With no other option left Rudra fights with Avantika and Ruchika, and loses his life. Unable to help him Shivangi watches as they bury him. Earlier, Shivangi murders Vikram in cold blood. Later, Shivangi tries to figure out the other killer who comes to meet Yamini.

videos.title: Shivangi Brings Rudra Back to Life
videos.overview: Devastated by Rudra’s death, Shivangi seeks the Swami’s help. He asks her to get a magical plant which is protected by the scorpion king. Shivangi fights the scorpion king and manages to bring back Rudra from the dead. Later, Akhilesh visits the Nikhanj house and shocks Yamini. What are his real motives?

videos.title: Shivangi Creates a Rift Between Yamini and Akhilesh
videos.overview: Finding out that Akhilesh's real motive is to get half of the 'naagmani' and that he was her father's murderer, Shivangi informs Rudra about her plan. She plans to create a rift between Yamini and Akhilesh, so that they end up killing each other. Earlier, Rudra cooks up some story and enters the Nikhanj house.

videos.title: Rift Between Shivangi and Rocky
videos.overview: Annoyed with the mystery that shrouds Shivangi and Rudra's relationship, Rocky confronts Shivangi about it. Will this misunderstanding cause problems in their relationship? Earlier, as Ruchika takes advantage of the misunderstanding between Shivangi and Rudra, the duo find out that Akhilesh has a 'kawach' with him. Later, Akhilesh reveals the 'kawach' to Yamini.

videos.title: Shivangi's 'naagin' Avatar Exposed!
videos.overview: Yamini feels that there is another 'Naagin' lurking in the house and seeks Kapalika's help to find its true identity. Subsequently, Kapalika summons a hawk and commands it to find the 'Naagin'. Meanwhile, Shivangi is with Rocky and is petrified to find herself transforming into her 'Naagin' form. When the hawk finds Shivangi and brings her to Kapalika, Yamini and the others are shocked to discover that Shivangi is the other 'Naagin'. How will Shivangi overcome this predicament?

videos.title: Rudra's Double Identity is Exposed!
videos.overview: Rocky reveals Rudra's ill intentions behind marrying Alia to the family, even Yamini gets a glimpse of Rudra's 'Nag' avatar. Earlier, to keep her identity of 'Ichadhari Naagin' a secret, Shivangi temporarily loses her powers by shedding her 'kechuli', but Ruchika gets hold of the 'kechuli'. Will Ruchika destroy Shivangi's 'kechuli', in order to destroy her? Or is there a twist in the tale? Tune-in to catch up with Naagin.

videos.title: Shivangi's Plan to Save The 'naagmani'
videos.overview: Yamini tries to burn Shivangi's 'kechuli' causing the latter to cry out in pain. However, ever so slyly, Rudra acquires the 'kechuli' from Yamini and stops her from hurting Shivangi. Shivangi and Rudra then devise an ingenious plan to stop Yamini and Ruchika from procuring the 'Naagmani'. Subsequently, during the heist, Rudra reveals his 'naag' avatar and starts a fierce battle with Ruchika and Avantika. Will Shivangi succeed in saving the 'Naagmani' from the clutches of the evil vixens?

videos.title: Shivangi's Search For Rudra
videos.overview: With the 'Naagmani' still out of her reach, Yamini is growing desperate. The Naagmani can be traced with the help of a ritual, but only someone with the mark of Suryavanshi can perform this ritual, and there is a deadline. Avantika points out that there is someone who qualifies for it - Shivangi. Only deception can make her perform the ceremony. Meanwhile, Shivangi gets lost when she goes searching for Rudra.

videos.title: The Battle For Naagmani
videos.overview: After tracing the location of the Naagmani, Yamini tries her best to procure it. Will Shivangi be able to spoil her evil plans? Earlier, Shivangi retrieves Rudra from Mahish's trap by breaking one of his horns. Meanwhile, a berserk Mahish orders Yamini to bring back his lost horn, and also informs about the existence of another serpent. While Ruchika conspires to kill Shivangi, Rudra convinces Shivangi to kill Rocky. Whose blood will spill?

videos.title: Shivangi Learns Rocky's Truth!
videos.overview: After learning that someone wants to kill Shivangi, Rocky goes to the 'Shiv Mandir'. But, to his surprise, he finds Shivangi there, waiting to take revenge on him. However, things take an unexpected turn when the masked man attacks Shivangi. Will Rocky comes to her rescue? Will Shivangi ever learn of Rocky's innocence?

videos.title: Shivangi Gets Her Revenge From Kapalika
videos.overview: Shivangi strikes one more name from her enemy list by killing Kapalika. Earlier, Shivangi and Rudra get trapped by Kapalika while chasing the masked killer of her mother. However, Rocky unknowingly breaks Kapalika's trap while searching for Shivangi and Dhruv in the cave. The situation turns fierce when Shivangi misleads Kapalika back to the cave and punishes her with a painful death.

videos.title: Shivangi is In a Dilemma
videos.overview: When Yamini asks Rocky to fill in for her at a meeting, Shivangi suspects that she is conspiring against him. True to her suspicion, Rocky gets injured in an accident. With his condition critical, Shivangi has to get hold of the Naagmani to save him. What will she do now?

videos.title: Shivangi is Stabbed!
videos.overview: Akhilesh stabs Shivangi to protect himself. Earlier, after getting hold of the Naagmani, he tries to sell it by manipulating Ruchika and Avantika. In order to keep the Naagmani safe, Shivangi attacks Akhilesh but gets stabbed by him instead. Will Shivangi survive?

videos.title: Mahesh Discovers Shivangi’s Identity
videos.overview: Mahesh in his plan to seek revenge discovers Shivangi’s identity. He decides to ignore it for the time being but as the Naagmani is in his possession, what will he utilise it for? Earlier witnessing Anky’s death, Mahesh escapes with the Naagmani and joins hands with Yamini to locate the serpents in the house.

videos.title: Shivangi Unveils Mahesh's Real Motives!
videos.overview: Shivangi unveils Mahesh's true motives when she meets his dying mentor. Unfortunately, she lands into striking a deal with Mahesh when she fails to destroy his 'horn'. Will she part with the 'Naagmani'?

videos.title: Shivangi Freezes Mahish to Death!
videos.overview: Restless to recover his horn from Shivangi, Mahish threatens to cause harm to Rocky's family. Shivangi tries to get rid of Mahish and freezes him to death. Meanwhile Yamini and her companions torture Shivangi's mentor and retrieve Mahish's horn.

videos.title: Will Shivangi be Able to Save Rocky?
videos.overview: Disguised as Mahish, Shivangi manages to trick Yamini into trading the 'horn' for a fake 'naagmani'. But all her efforts go in vain when Mahish abducts Rocky and stabs him.

videos.title: Shivangi and Ruchika Join Forces
videos.overview: Shivangi needs the naagmani to save Rocky's life. She joins forces with Ruchika to recover the naagmani from Mahish and bring Rocky back to life. Will she be successful in her mission? Earlier Mahish manages to retrieve his horn and steal Shivangi and Rudra's powers.

videos.title: Shivangi Kills Mahish
videos.overview: Shivangi takes the form of Goddess Durga and kills Mahish. She retrieves the naagmani from him and brings Rocky back to life. Meanwhile Avantika is surprised to find Mahish dead. Will she find out who did it?

videos.title: Shivangi Warns Gautami

videos.overview: Guruji alerts Ahana about Dragon King Bahumath, while Yaman offers Ahana a deal to get back his dragon pearl and leave Pinky's life.

videos.title: Radhika's Ultimate Darkness Emerges
videos.overview: Pinky's wedding turns tragic when Yaman is found dead, raising Ahana's suspicions. Radhika awakens as the ultimate dragon, hinting at an epic Naagin–Dragon battle ahead.

videos.title: Radhika Plots Against Ahana
videos.overview: As power and betrayal collide, Radhika secretly weaves a dangerous plan to bring Ahana down. While Ahana senses something amiss, hidden motives and dark forces begin to surface.

videos.title: The Dragon Conspiracy Unfolds
videos.overview: Ahana fights off goons to save Tina, foiling Parmeet's plan. A shocking twist unfolds as Radhika reveals how Basha and the scientists tested on her to awaken the ultimate dragon.

videos.title: Aryaman Hands Divorce Papers
videos.overview: A tiger sent by Radhika confronts Ahana, who transforms into a naagin, sparking a fierce battle. Soon after, Ahana is heartbroken as Aryaman hands her their signed divorce papers.

videos.title: Ahana's Revenge Awakens
videos.overview: Shattered by Aryaman's betrayal, Ahana's pain turns into fierce rage as she embraces her Naagin powers. As Radhika tightens her grip and dark forces rise, Ahana vows revenge.

videos.title: Erul Halts the Weddings
videos.overview: As Ahana prepares to marry Vikram and Radhika weds Aryaman, the wedding turns dramatic when Erul storms in. Chaos erupts as hidden motives surface and loyalties are tested.

videos.title: Radhika’s Deadly Betrayal
videos.overview: Ahana reclaims her identity as the Anant-kul Naagrani and the Nagmani. However, her in-laws frame her for murder while the secretive Radhika begins targeting her.
